summary: Backflip Madness! Fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports backflip game.
description:
Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!

Features:
- Multiple backflips and locations
- Parkour/Free running acrobatics
- Realistic ragdoll physics and simulation
- Achievements and leaderboards
- 3 difficulty levels
- Action replay
- Normal and ninja outfits
- Realistic back flip tricks simulation

Simple and addictive backflip platformer game. Jump from the roof or platform, flip form the cliff, train backflips and become real flip master! Take a break, kill the time, make some backflips or epic fails!

Dive into a world of adrenaline-fueled acrobatics with Backflip Madness! A fast-paced, parkour-inspired extreme sports extravaganza where your mission is as thrilling as it gets - perform spectacular tricks and heart-stopping stunts that defy gravity. Can you push the boundaries and take your flips to the extreme?

Unleash your inner acrobat with:

🔹 Varied Locations and Backflips: Conquer different environments and master an array of backflips. Each flip is a new challenge, a new adventure, a new madness!

🔹 Parkour and Free Running Acrobatics: Sprint, leap, and somersault your way through breathtaking parkour-inspired scenarios. The city is your playground!

🔹 Hyper-Realistic Physics: Feel every exhilarating twist and turn with our realistic ragdoll physics and simulations. It's as close to actual flipping as you can get!

🔹 Compete and Achieve: Crush records and climb leaderboards with Game Center integration. Compete with friends, challenge rivals and show off your spectacular skills.

🔹 Three Difficulty Levels: From parkour beginners to seasoned tricksters, we've got challenges that'll keep everyone on their toes.

🔹 Action Replay: Relive your most stunning stunts and hilarious epic fails with our action replay. Every flip, every fall, caught on tape!

🔹 Customize Your Look: Choose from normal or ninja outfits to perform your stunts in style. Stand out as you flip out!

Backflip Madness is more than just a game – it's a passion, it's a challenge, it's a lifestyle! Whether you're looking to kill time, take a break, or become the ultimate flip master, our simple yet addictive platformer is the perfect fit. Ready to flip the world upside down?
